gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-literata: Literata brings a sturdy, bookish seriousness, its thin lines firm and its curves open wide, while Delius Unicase loosens everything above it. The handwritten heading and the serif text give each other something to push against.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-merriweather-sa: Tall, sturdy lowercase makes Merriweather Sans look big and plain-spoken, with an e that opens clearly to the right. Delius Unicase would feel lost if shrunk too small, since its hand-drawn charm needs room.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-fs-ranade: Delius Unicase writes its relaxed, inviting heading in one unbroken line thickness, then Ranade follows with slightly shifting weight and stroke ends set far apart. That slight wobble in the text is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-abeezee: Delius Unicase hands over a loose, friendly heading with a pronounced x-height, and ABeeZee follows with open terminals and a neon-tube thickness. Make the heading tiny and the hand-drawn charm would fade.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-aldrich: Delius Unicase sets a relaxed, hand-drawn tone with no tapering anywhere, while Aldrich holds a modern line with round letters that look cupped. The handwriting loosens it, and the text stays crisp beneath.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-alexandria: Delius Unicase looks hand-drawn and inviting, its strokes showing no difference between up and side, while Alexandria stands tall with wide open terminals. Long stretches of text would feel clean and steady.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-amiko: A rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts gives Delius Unicase its relaxed, handwritten look, and Amiko sets modern, outward-pointing terminals beneath it. The strongest quality is the contrast of hand and machine.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-bangla: Loose and friendly, Delius Unicase holds its line thickness all the way through, while Anek Bangla adds wide s curves barely curled in. Longer text would read in a contemporary, approachable way.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-devanagari: Delius Unicase draws a relaxed heading without any thick-thin pulse. Anek Devanagari answers with distinctly open letter mouths and a tall middle zone, so handwriting meets a modern, tidy text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-gujarati: Hand-drawn and inviting, Delius Unicase keeps its stroke edges parallel through every curve, while Anek Gujarati lets its lowercase rival the capitals. The strongest quality is how openly friendly both look.
